hypothesis: L012 showed that homogeneous kmeans3 specialization was harmful overall, but its route-level evidence was heterogeneous: cluster2 achieved 2.9293 K MAE on 1,242 rows and contained no high-Tc cases, whereas cluster1 was especially poor. Using only an extra_trees/raw cluster2 expert while letting cluster0 and cluster1 fall back to the G01 global extra_trees/raw model may retain cluster2's low-temperature benefit without the errors introduced by the other cluster experts.
falsification: The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K, representing at least the required 0.01 K gain over A05, and positive-Tc MAE is at most the fixed G01 guard of 8.832165507919859 K. Route-specific or reported-zero gains without both conditions are only subgroup tradeoffs.
reason: The required successful-unique-cycle minimum remains pending, so continuation is mandatory. This untried selective-routing ablation directly isolates the apparently useful cluster2 expert identified by L012 while removing its harmful cluster0 and cluster1 experts. L012 itself failed the deterministic guard and was 0.5278 K worse than A05, so it is not an eligible win; the proposed experiment tests whether that failure arose from the poor cluster0/cluster1 experts rather than kmeans routing as a whole. Any result remains adaptive fixed-fold training OOF evidence, and kmeans cluster identities may shift between folds.
